cases.scope: Finite three-member admission-prefix abstraction over every busy-member subset, under exclusive host lifecycle ownership and stable list membership. Busy FFI admission rejects before commit, reopens the closed prefix, and permits a retry only after actual callback return. Per-attempt work accounting rejects redundant scans and bounds gate operations by twice the inspected VM count; arbitrary processor-population arithmetic is a separate conditional Lean proof. Counts are work units, not a wall-clock, CAS-retry or lock-wait bound. Three members are protocol positions, not a CPU limit. No constructor allocation failure, OS join failure, root sticky recovery, weak-memory C refinement or full lifecycle admission.
